trees.readme:
# Negative control of the alpha gate

Deliberately defective inputs. `tools/check-alpha.mjs` runs all three of its points on each
of them and **requires every one to be rejected — and rejected by the point it declares**.

## The cases

| case            | point | check    | rule      | defect                  |
| --------------- | ----: | -------- | --------- | ----------------------- |
| `a-case`        |     1 | `first`  | `broken`  | the first thing breaks  |
| `another-case`  |     2 | `second` | —         | the second thing breaks |
| `a-third-case`  |     3 | `third`  | `unnamed` | the third thing breaks  |

# Negative control of the beta gate

Deliberately defective inputs. `tools/check-beta.mjs` runs all five of its points on each of
them and **requires every one to be rejected**. This one keeps no table of its cases, which is
a state the gate measures rather than forbids.

map.text:
00-axis.md      LEVEL 0   the one requirement every other one is ordered by
requirements/   LEVEL 1   promises: what has to be true                (2 entries)
decisions/      LEVEL 2   why this way, and what it costs us           (3 ADRs)
lessons.md                the evidence base: what actually happened    (5 entries)
plan.md                   the task list — the only place holding "done"
